ourRead: Annual opens preselected in a yellow card at $34.99, beside a struck $69.99. Monthly, $12.99, is the anchor: 12 months cost $155.88, so full-price Annual saves 55%.
A first-year discount stands in for a free trial: $34.99 is charged on day one, and year two renews at the full $69.99.
The App Store lists 10 items at 3 prices under 4 names. "Headspace Plus" costs $12.99 or $94.99, exactly like "Headspace", so it is 1 tier.

improvements.title: Name what the year buys
improvements.detail: The top line reads "Limited time offer". Swap it for what the year buys, with numbers from the App Store text: "500+ guided meditations, from 3 minutes".
improvements.rule: Make headlines specific. "Track 3 habits in 10 seconds a day" beats "Transform your life".

improvements.title: Say 50% off once
improvements.detail: The page says "50% off" 3 times, in the headline, the blue badge and the fine print, beside a struck $69.99. Drop the badge: the struck price already shows the deal.
improvements.rule: Delete filler badges ("New", "AI-powered", "Beta") unless they change a decision.

improvements.title: Keep the bright colors to 2
improvements.detail: Yellow, blue, orange and green share one white page. Keep the yellow card and the blue button. Set the orange links and the green check in the headline's grey #44423F: the links go from 3.3:1 to 10:1.
improvements.rule: Two colors do 90% of the work. The third one only goes on the button you want pressed.

stylePrompt: Build a paywall in Headspace's style. Top to bottom: the logo, a bold 2-line offer headline, 2 stacked plan cards, a grey renewal line, 2 links and a full-width pill button. Type: Hanken Grotesk, close to Headspace Apercu: bold headline and prices, regular labels. Colors: white #FFFFFF (60) for the page, orange #FF7300 (30) for the logo and selected card, blue #1A54F6 (10) for the button only. Preselect Annual with its first-year price beside the struck full price. Monthly sits below, outlined. Price Annual per year and Monthly per month. Offer 50% off year one in place of a trial. Use my brand colors in the same 60/30/10 roles.
